decisions.reason: As a construction site dumper it builds directly on the firm's existing knowledge in specialized vehicles, material handling and service, so management is likely to keep it and improve it rather than withdraw it soon.
The inclined furniture lift draws on the firm's lifting, safety and maintenance capabilities, but the end market is somewhat less central to its core niches, so it is kept with more caution.
An inclined building material lift fits the firm's construction and lifting knowledge base well, giving it enough absorptive capacity to learn from early use and refine the product.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift combines vehicle integration and lifting technology the firm already understands, although niche demand uncertainty means management would monitor it closely.
